parts.text: A closure can come into force while drones of several companies are already in the air, and authorities can announce sudden closures that apply at once or planned ones that are often amended during the day. Radio coverage is patchy, especially around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, and reports from drones can arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all. Batteries drain faster in cold and wind than planned, and the links used to give instructions to drones and charging equipment can deliver an instruction twice while the sender cannot tell whether the first attempt arrived.
